text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Why a grid? Which answer is strongest?
Why is a grid better than dots and lines for the Les Misérables network? Hands up: A, B or C.

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: “The grid is better because it looks neater and more organised.”

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: “The grid is better because the lines in the tangle cross too
much, so you can’t read it.”

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: “With 254 lines, the dots-and-lines picture is a tangle you cannot
follow. A grid gives each pair one square, so no lines cross:
whether Javert and Fantine share a scene is one square to check.”
